title: Hinomori Shizuku — A Special Spell〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Once this song is over, it'll be our turn.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, Minori already seemed very nervous. I hope she's okay...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Hehe. Looks like Haruka helped calm her down.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, so...
You just seemed to be focusing very hard just now...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sorry if I interrupted you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
It's just...
I am feeling pretty stoked now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The stage I've been wanting to perform on is right there. I can hear the audience and feel the electricity in the air...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Doesn't that make you want to go out there and knock their socks off? This tension in the air is what Idol Lovers is all about!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You coming over to talk to me has helped me relax, so all that's left is for me to go out there and show just how hard I've been training!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It also feels like it's been so long since we waited to go on stage like this...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The joint performance our agency held a long time ago comes to mind.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Do you remember?
I was feeling so nervous before going on stage, but then you...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I have to make today's show a success...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I have to be the perfect Shizuku Hinomori everybody expects me to be...!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Huh...?!
Oh, Airi, it's you. Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I came to see how you were doing since you're going on soon...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And you look as nervous as I was expecting you to be.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm starting to wonder if I'll be able to go out there and perform without making any mistakes...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But you're in luck, Shizuku!
Today, I'm going to teach you a special spell that will ensure that you'll do great on stage!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yup!
So, turn that way for me...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'll place my hands on your back and...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (She's giving me so much encouragement just by touching my back...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I feel much better now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: See? I do this with the other members of QT, but it really works!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I didn't know that. Thank you, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know that you've been practicing more than anyone else!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So, I'm sure you'll do just fine on stage.
Have confidence in yourself!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I will!
Thank you! I'll go now!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The spell you cast on me that time helped me relax and put on a good performance. So...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Can I do the same for you?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'd like to return the favor and give you any support that I can.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh... If you're offering, then yes, please.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I watched you practice so hard for your moment on this stage.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
So, I know you'll do just fine.
Let's go out there and put on the best performance ever.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thanks.
That was just the boost of energy I needed.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You and Haruka put me through the blender, so there's no way I'm gonna let this chance go to waste! Let's go blow the roof off this place!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (To go out on that stage with Airi and the others, and give it absolutely everything we have!)
